text:
Chhath Puja 2026 Calendar: When Is Chathh Puja? Date, Significance, Rituals, Sunset And Sunrise Timings
Chhath Puja 2026 Calendar: The four‑day festival begins with Nahay Khay, followed by Kharna, Sandhya Arghya and Usha Arghya rituals, with devotion and offerings to Surya Dev.
Chhath Puja 2026: Dedicated to the worship of the sun or Surya Dev and his sister, Chhathi Maiya (Prakriti), the goddess of fertility, Chhath Puja is a famous festival which holds special significance in eastern India, particularly in states like Bihar, eastern Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand and neighbouring regions.
The festival, which takes place over four days, is generally celebrated in the month of October or November. On this auspicious occasion, devotees express their gratitude to the sun and nature.
Recommended Stories
The term Chhath translates to sixth, which signifies the sixth day of the lunar month of Kartika (October–November). The celebrations commence on the Chaturthi Tithi of the Shukla Paksha (waxing moon) in the month of Kartika and it comes to an end on the Saptami Tithi.
Here, we take a look at all key aspects of Chhath Puja 2026.
Chhath Puja 2026 Calendar
Day 1: Nahay Khay
- Date: Friday, November 13, 2026 (Chaturthi)
- Ritual: Taking a holy dip and preparing simple meals.
Day 2: Lohanda & Kharna
- Date: Saturday, November 14, 2026 (Panchami)
- Ritual: Beginning a 36-hour fast, followed by a special meal (Kheer).
Day 3: Chhath Puja (Sandhya Arghya)
- Date: Sunday, November 15, 2026 (Shashthi)
- Ritual: Offering Arghya (water/milk) to the setting sun.
Day 4: Usha Arghya & Parana
- Date: Monday, November 16, 2026 (Saptami)
- Ritual: Offering Arghya to the rising sun, followed by breaking the fast (Parana).
Chhath Puja 2026 Date and Muhurat
According to Drik Panchang, this year Chhath Puja will be celebrated on Sunday, November 15. As per Drik Panchang, Shashthi Tithi will begin this year at 11:23 PM on November 14, and it will end at 2:00 AM two days later on November 16.
Find out more details about Chhath Puja 2026, as per Drik Panchang.
- Sunrise on Chhath Puja Day: 06:44 AM
- Sunset on Chhath Puja Day: 05:28 PM
Chhath Puja 2026 Significance
From expressing gratitude to Surya Dev to fostering spiritual growth, the significances of Chhath Puja are manifold. It must be noted that the festival is more than just a ritual; it is a spiritual journey of purity, devotion and discipline. On this grand occasion, devotees worship Lord Surya, the God of Energy and Light, revered as the source of life and well-being.

Chhath Puja 2026: FAQs
Why we celebrate Chhath Puja?
The festival is marked to worship the God of Sun and seek blessings for the well-being and happiness of families.
